description: This is the main application component for a note-taking web app built with React. It manages notes state, selection, addition, deletion, persistence via local storage, and integrates various UI components like Navbar, NotesSidebar, NoteEditor, and VideoModal.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID, default title, empty content, timestamps, adds it to the notes state, and sets it as selected.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note by ID from the notes list and updates the selected note accordingly.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note identified by ID with given properties and refreshes its timestamp.
